summary: Verified all 8 fixes for RealProfits eSign + Invoice apps. 8/8 backend pytest tests pass; UI checks pass for every issue via Playwright on the prod-mode frontend.

tested_issues.Issue 1 (P0) - 401 redirect to /login?re: PASS — both /tools/esign/dashboard and /tools/invoice unauthenticated visits redirected to /login?redirect=<path>. Backend confirmed 401 on /api/invoices and /api/esign/documents without cookie.
tested_issues.Issue 2 (P0) - Drafts openable: PASS — created draft via API, dashboard shows edit-draft-<id> button + open-draft-<id> link, both navigate to /tools/esign/edit/<id>; wizard loaded at step 2 (step-2-signers) with signers prefilled (Alice Smith/alice@test.com, Bob Jones/bob@test.com) and signing_order persisted.
tested_issues.Issue 3 (P1) - In Progress tab between S: PASS — 5 filter buttons present in correct order: All, Draft, Sent, In Progress, Completed (data-testid filter-all/draft/sent/in_progress/completed).
tested_issues.Issue 4 (P1) - Drag handles on sequentia: PASS — handles only visible when signing_order=sequential (handles=2 in sequential, 0 in parallel). reorder-hint visible. Toggling restores handles correctly.
tested_issues.Issue 5 (P1) - FieldPlacer sticky sideba: PASS — sidebar element has classes 'lg:sticky lg:top-32 lg:self-start' (also lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-9rem)] lg:overflow-y-auto).
tested_issues.Issue 6 (P1) - Invoice qty/description f: PASS — InvoicePreviewPanel shows qty '1' (no '.0', no 'hr'); empty description renders empty (no literal 'Item'). Backend public portal HTML verified via pytest: qty=1 renders '1', qty=2.5 renders '2.5', no '1.0', no 'hr', no '>Item'.
tested_issues.Issue 7 (P2) - Home link in eSign dashbo: PASS — esign-back-home link present with href='/'.
tested_issues.Issue 8 (P2) - Usage banner no progress: PASS — usage-banner contains no div with width%; visible '0 / 5 documents used' and 'Upgrade for unlimited' link only.

critical_code_review_comments: EsignWizard.tsx is 637 lines — close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting step-2 signer table and step-3 placeholder logic into separate components for maintainability.
InvoiceApp.tsx is 810 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend extracting the PDF/export helpers and the items table into separate modules.

EsignDashboard usage-banner shows the upgrade link only when docs_used_this_month >= limit; works as intended but the empty 'remaining' calculation can read awkwardly when limit is null on paid tier — minor copy polish.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Draft_iter39 esign document with 2 sequential signers (Alice Smith, Bob Jones). Invoice tests create and cleanup TEST_QtyClient invoices automatically.
